expectations.text: The normal sequence is authorize, import, review mappings, Start sync after all mapped; import alone does not start sync.
expectations.evidence: Steps authorize desired shop, Import products, review mappings, then Start sync after all mapped; explicitly says importing alone does not start order sync.

expectations.text: It gives Mapping status location, Mapped/Unmatched conditions, and Link item or inventory-lead remedy only for Unmatched rows.
expectations.evidence: Names Connections > Products and Mapping status; leaves Mapped mappings as-is and supplies Link item or inventory-lead creation only for Unmatched rows.

expectations.text: Disconnect/reimport and Reauthorize are clearly conditional on wrong shop and Authorization expired respectively, not universal prerequisites.
expectations.evidence: Disconnect recovery is restricted to wrong shop in Connections > Account; Reauthorize is restricted to Authorization expired status.
